roasts.title: Roast My TechStack #6

speakers.name: Jesse Sng
speakers.summary: Parallel content pipeline (one input to podcast, blog, images, audio). Plan orchestration up front, fail-continue then retry, Imagen cheaper but no text-in-image, GPT Image for text.

speakers.name: Gaurav Kumar Manek
speakers.summary: Evals overlap with guardrails; guardrails can be deterministic code. Limit blast radius by infrastructure (separate machine) or by action (draft not send, mark not delete). Slides: evals-for-ai-agents-slides.pdf.

keyTakeaways: Fail-continue beats fail-fast in parallel workflows — keep partial success, retry later.
Imagen is cheaper but can't render text in images; GPT Image can.
Guardrails can be deterministic code, and blast radius can be capped by infrastructure or progressive actions.
discussionPoints: Parallel generation: orchestration and piecing things together
Error management: continue first, then retry
Image cursive improvement with ComfyUI, video with Remotion
Observability: Grafana for light work, Prometheus for heavier

roasts.title: Roast My TechStack #5

speakers.name: Richard Lee
speakers.summary: Executive agent controlling siloed, purpose-built child agents. Hallucination countered with multi-layer grounding. Don't over-engineer: monolith first, transition to scale later. Deck: github.com/yaksheng/techies-scape-260521.

speakers.name: Alec Teo
speakers.summary: Auth after 3 plays for lower friction; Supabase native but messaging weaker, Clerk uptime worse. Review schema yourself. Agent-ready via isitagentready.com. Offload pixelation to user device. Imagen 4 ~6x cheaper.

speakers.name: Dalton Prescott Ng
speakers.summary: Virtual graph layer for AI agents on Postgres. Graph DB ~34x cheaper than Neo4j. Hydration enables fraud detection. RAG for search, Graph for entity relations.

keyTakeaways: Hallucination in multi-agent systems needs multiple layers of grounding.
Start with a monolith, not micro-services.
Destructive ops: deterministic code; auth never rolled by hand — containerise it.
RAG is for search; graphs are for entity relations.
discussionPoints: LLM-as-judge for image eval: different model + scientific database

roasts.title: Roast My TechStack #4

speakers.name: Ying Zhao
speakers.summary: Production-style LinkedIn analytics. Get data via API / scraping / 3rd party. Bronze→silver→gold medallion. Retries + backoff to avoid bill shock. One Big Table over relational for query speed.

speakers.name: Ee One Lim
speakers.summary: Caregiver support navigation. RAG > raw LLM when you have a single source of truth. n8n dynamic model selector, uses LLM websearch vs RAG. Postgres for RAG store. Eval tool in Claude, Kapso for WhatsApp business.

speakers.name: Kaleb Nim
speakers.summary: AI-voice interview app that answers real-time. Oracle free tier forever: 24GB RAM 4cpu 10TB egress. Whisper TTS for speech. Guardrails via persona.md.

keyTakeaways: RAG beats a raw LLM when you have a single source of truth.
Oracle Cloud's forever-free tier is enough for side projects.
Simplest AI guardrails start with a persona.md.
discussionPoints: How to get LinkedIn data: API, scraping, 3rd party analytics
Retries and backoff for LLM calls and APIs
One Big Table vs relationship database

roasts.title: Roast My TechStack #3

speakers.name: Abdelrahman Fliou
speakers.summary: Pricing copilot. Parse PDFs to Markdown: Docling for images, MarkItDown for text, pdfplumber for Python. Deterministic code for numeric analysis and audit trail. No real-time API calls. Model-specific choice: gpt-4o mini for categorization, conversational model for negotiation.

speakers.name: Gaurav Kumar Manek
speakers.summary: Counter-intuitive storage that worked best at Visigoth.ai. Mimics functional programming. Disk write off the critical path = no user-visible latency, only possible because immutable. FastAPI over Flask.

speakers.name: Arul Kumaran
speakers.summary: Build & render programmatic video with React (Remotion). Voicebox clones your voice locally. FFmpeg for decode/encode. Google Gemma for lightweight video summarization.

keyTakeaways: Deterministic code for numeric analysis keeps an audit trail.
Push disk writes off the critical path — possible because data is immutable.
Bookend media workloads with Remotion, Voicebox, FFmpeg, and light Gemma models.
discussionPoints: Relational DB path: DuckDB or Postgres upsert

roasts.title: Roast My TechStack #2

speakers.name: Marcus Liang
speakers.summary: Self-improving software workflow: user complaint via chatbot → GitHub issue → OpenClaw cron → Claude Code skill generates & applies fix → human tests → resolve/redeploy. Eval blog by Hamel, shadcn for UI.

speakers.name: Ee One Lim
speakers.summary: Teach Spanish through music. LRCLib for lyrics, Stitch + Google MCP for frontend design, Heartmula as open-source music LLM / YouTube API alternative. Push API calls to frontend to avoid Google API blocks.

speakers.name: Jesse Lim
speakers.summary: Drag-and-drop flow automation. Don't reach for the biggest model for everything — escalate per task. Get AI to write documentation. Let the AI wait for you.

keyTakeaways: Self-healing loops: route complaints into GitHub issues and let agents ship fixes with human validation.
Escalate models deliberately, don't use one model for everything.
Push API calls to the frontend to dodge provider blocks.
discussionPoints: Self-improvement software workflow via Claude Code
Lyrics, design & streaming stack for music language apps
Acceptance criteria with screenshots for UI control
